sources.title: Dataset related to article: Longitudinal neurofunctional changes in medication overuse headache patients after mindfulness practice in a randomized controlled trial (the MIND-CM study)

sources.title: Data from: An fMRI-based neural marker for migraine without aura
sources.evidence: 版本32231的完整文件清单仅一份493,920字节DOCX；网页下载403、官方API下载401，正文未取得。
sources.next: 论文的逐人表描述不等于本项目已取得表，更不等于取得T1/BOLD、身份或MRI时间。

sources.title: OpenPain
sources.evidence: 首页和使用协议均实际HTTP200；下载入口经使用协议进入注册，尚无本项目可配对清单。
sources.next: 需要已有授权访问的文件/清单；本轮未提交身份、接受协议或联系他人。

sources.title: CoSpine Pain-dataset
sources.evidence: 作者README实际读取：39名健康人，热刺激任务及疼痛/不愉快度评分；没有据此取得临床患者队列。
sources.next: 若另做实验热痛研究需单列设计，不能替代慢性疼痛诊断或治疗验证。

sources.title: Antithrombotic therapy for migraine in patients with patent foramen ovale: A randomized clinical trial
sources.evidence: 官方元数据和完整4文件清单实际读取：临床/日记、字典和SAS代码；当前说明未列MRI，未下载逐人数据。
sources.next: 可参考终点与临床字段，不能称为已经具备影像增量验证输入。

historical_exclusions: The new search hit for ds005713 refers to the historical source; it does not prove a new independent cohort or authorize stopped TN14 work.
limitations: Provider descriptions and file inventories do not establish actual paired people, clinical timing, QC, access permission or identity independence.
No available source in this review established all requirements for the three independent clinical endpoints.
Existing strong-FC findings and the active migraine input protocol remain unchanged.
